key_insight: ReactNexus discovers kinetically guided chemical reaction networks from reactant graphs without predefined products or reaction templates.
engineering_relevance: The framework can help engineers investigate reaction selectivity, competing catalytic pathways, and candidate structures for interpreting complex reaction mixtures.
method: Generate candidate transition states and full reactant-to-product trajectories.
Use a machine-learned interatomic potential to verify connectivity and evaluate electronic barriers.
Expand reaction networks to identify accessible intermediates and competing pathways.
evidence_signal: In an in-distribution benchmark of 10,000 generated candidates, 80.8% connected to the input reactant after DFT optimization and intrinsic reaction coordinate verification.
watch_item: The reported in-distribution connectivity rate does not establish network completeness or reliability for unfamiliar reaction chemistries.
paper_title: Generative discovery of chemical reaction networks
